correctness.rationale: PASS: From actual composition domains [a,b]∩[c−d,f−d] and [c,f]∩[a−e,b−e], equality of two nonempty product intervals is an iff endpoint criterion. Its sign-case partition is disjoint: both zero shifts give binom(n+1,2)^2−2binom(n+2,4), exactly one zero contributes four binom(n+3,5), both positive/negative give two binom(n+1,4), opposite signs impossible by inconsistent left endpoints. Each parametrization is bijective, so holds for all n≥2. Together with independent mutual-annihilation Z_n and zero-factor count 2N_n−1 it gives C_n and 3/10+3/(10n)+15/(8n²)+O(n^-3). Independent direct composition over all enumerated partial-map pairs for n≤8 checked 74,732 ordered pairs; finite tests corroborate rather than prove all n.
